sources.title: Vermont DEC Deerfield basin plan appendices
American Whitewater Green River to West Leyden
USGS Green River near Colrain, MA 01170100
Massachusetts Green River WMA access and parking
New England Paddler Green River access points

screening.reach: Green River crib dam / Stage Road to West Leyden Road, about 6.8 miles in the Vermont DEC basin plan; American Whitewater separately lists Green River to West Leyden at 6.2 miles, Class II–III.
screening.demandSignal: A named intermediate whitewater reach on the Deerfield River tributary, with established paddler documentation.
screening.scoringSignal: American Whitewater links the reach to USGS 01170100 near Colrain, but its reviewed page supplies no static numeric runnable range. Its live ‘below recommended’ status is not itself a numeric threshold.
screening.accessSignal: The basin plan names Stage Road/Green River crib dam and West Leyden Road endpoints. MassWildlife identifies nearby WMA parcels and fishing access, not a maintained boat launch.
blockers: The Vermont DEC basin plan identifies the Green River crib dam as privately owned.
American Whitewater states that its route coordinates are very approximate; the lower roadside landing is not verified as a public water-entry facility.
The two published route lengths differ (6.8 versus 6.2 miles), and the exact endpoints have not been reconciled.
No defensible route-specific numeric flow band was found in the reviewed sources.

decision: Do not add or score until public on-water access, exact endpoint coordinates, route length, and route-specific flow guidance are independently confirmed.
